series.label: Ronin Rain
series.blurb: Lone blades in wet streets — ronin weather, empty armour, and the long walk home.

series.label: Quiet Rain
series.blurb: Soft weather, sharp silence — umbrellas, windows, and streets that hush instead of shout.

series.label: Starbound
series.blurb: Starfields and siren light — cosmic queens and deep-space glow without the franchise labels.

series.label: Crimson Sun
series.blurb: Blood-red skies, steel, and standing ground — a pack and print lane for heat and last stands.

series.label: Crimson Oni
series.blurb: Masks that don’t sleep — shrine light, crimson vigil, and faces that watch the night.

series.label: Neon Cyberpunk
series.blurb: City veins and electric rain — night drives, alleys, and neon that never quite turns off.
